summary: Parabilis Medicines filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of 4,166,666 voting common shares to Regeneron Pharmaceuticals at $18.00/share (90% of the $20.00 IPO price), closing concurrently with its IPO on June 11, 2026. The transaction is a routine concurrent private placement by the issuer, not a special situation. Regeneron receives piggyback registration rights. The shares were issued under Section 4(a)(2) without registration. No premium, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed. This is an ordinary equity issuance, not an activist, tender, or strategic event. What to watch: the IPO and concurrent placement are closed; no further action is required.
